answer: Each identity holds an opal slot, posts a self-assessed price, pays 2% an epoch as tax. Anyone may buy a slot at its price; bought ones lose standing. A hollow identity prices low and is bought out, or high and bleeds. 1,000 fakes at 500 pay 10,000 an epoch, 100,000 over ten, vs a 40,000 pool. A kernel record binds price to owner key; buyers snap up cheap slots and the lowball dodge fails. One honest slot costs 10 an epoch, its share stays whole.
